title: Fix device login initialization with a shared authentication action
summary: A shared authentication action now handles device login initialization for AL-Go workflows, ensuring credentials are validated and helpers are available before sign-in instructions are displayed.
key_points: New Authenticate action centralizes credential checks and device-login setup across workflows
Credentials passed through environment variables instead of PowerShell source interpolation
Existing credential precedence and admin secret name configuration preserved
Missing credentials and invalid responses now fail explicitly with detailed messages
Applied to CreateOnlineDevelopmentEnvironment and PublishToEnvironment workflows in both app templates
